scope: Generated synthetic reproductions during independent source review only
source_hash_limit: Source was still under active revision. No immutable pre-fix hash was captured for these initial exploratory reproductions. Final regressions must bind the confirmed freeze.

findings.reproduction: Create grid from 30 generated alternating 90/110 closes with decision T, current 100, replacement budget 200. Emit paid initial buy a. Fully fill a, then emit successor sell b in the same slot. Call old on_cancel_confirmed(a.slot).
findings.observed: Successor sell b is silently removed because cancellation is keyed only by slot.
findings.required_regression: Old order cancellation must reject before mutating successor, including after partial fill, confirmed cancel and reissue.

findings.reproduction: Fully fill buy a and emit successor sell b, then deliver old buy quantity with a.slot and a timestamp eligible for b.
findings.observed: Old buy callback is applied as sell b; owned inventory becomes zero and slot returns to BUY.
findings.required_regression: Callbacks require immutable order identity, side and unique fill identity. Duplicate and stale callbacks must fail closed without mutation.

findings.reproduction: Provide otherwise complete canonical scalar report with complete_calendar='False', paid_flat='False'.
findings.observed: PASS_OBSERVED_RISK_ONLY was returned. Integer no_topup=1 was also accepted as canonical True.
findings.required_regression: Require literal booleans and refuse economic certification without independently bound native snapshots.

findings.classification: Input contract gap with overbroad helper claim
findings.reproduction: Original weights (.2,.1,-.1,0,0), retained legs (.18,0,0,0,0) or empty, pending BTC buy weight .02, zero free/reserved cash and zero requested notional.
findings.observed: Helper allowed=True when original shorts/other legs were dropped, and allowed=True for positive pending buys despite zero cash/request inputs.
findings.required_regression: Bind retained net lineage, valuation and reservation/request notionals; helper arithmetic alone may never certify native wallet execution.

findings.reproduction: Emit buy at T, observe price again at T+10 minutes, then fill at original eligible T+1 minute+1us.
findings.observed: Backdated fill was admitted after the later observation.
findings.required_regression: All admitted fill, cancel and price-observation events share monotone causal clocks; reject before mutation.

findings.classification: Unimplemented scheduler behavior presented as fixed weekly session
findings.reproduction: Create a session and call intents at T+30 days without manually invoking expire().
findings.observed: Old session emitted a successor sell intent.
findings.required_regression: Fixed session end disables new intents automatically while retaining executable pending orders and inventory. Native paid exit and no-overlap remain separate adapter prerequisites.
